item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated the war in Ukraine is nearing its end. item.title: Two Singaporeans confirmed dead in Indonesia volcano eruption, official says
item.description: Search efforts for two missing Singaporeans at Mount Dukono are hindered by volcanic eruptions and heavy rain. Local guides are being investigated for leading tourists near the active crater, an area officially closed within a 4km radius. Authorities told CNA that several local guides are under probe for bringing a group of Singaporean tourists and Indonesian nationals close to the crater, despite the area within a 4km radius being closed for any activities.

item.title: One Dead After Being Hit By Frontier Airlines Plane That Was Taking Off From Denver
item.description: A Frontier Airlines plane struck and killed a ground worker during takeoff at Denver International Airport. The incident occurred one day after a Delta Air Lines employee died in a similar accident at Orlando International Airport. The incident came a day after a Delta Air Lines employee was killed while on the job at the Orlando International Airport.

item.title: EAM Jaishankar hands over India-assisted agro-processing facility in South Trinidad
item.description: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar inaugurated an India-assisted agro-processing facility in South Trinidad. This visit is part of his three-nation tour to enhance India's engagement with Caribbean nations. S. Jaishankar arrived in Port of Spain from Paramaribo on May 8 on the concluding leg of his three-nation tour of Jamaica, Suriname, and Trinidad and Tobago, aimed at deepening India’s engagement with the Caribbean nations.

item.title: Faint Meow In Mississippi Tornado Rubble Leads To Stunning Rescue
item.description: A kitten was rescued from tornado debris in Mississippi after its faint meows were heard. The kitten is now safe and has already attracted significant interest from potential adopters. Ashton Lemley says there's already a lot of interest from people who want to adopt the kitten.

item.title: Buddhist monk arrested over alleged rape of teen in Sri Lanka
item.description: Sri Lankan police arrested Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero, a prominent Buddhist monk, on suspicion of rape. He holds a highly respected position within the global Buddhist community. The arrest follows an investigation into allegations involving a teenager. The Venerable Pallegama Hemarathana Thero holds one of the most revered positions in the Buddhist world.
